The leaders of Luxembourg, Moldova, Estonia and EU Council President Antonio Costa are also in Kyiv for the talks hosted on Ukraine's Independence Day and which come amid the war's latest escalation. (Photo by Henry NICHOLLS / POOL / AFP via Getty Images)
